data.name: InterEarth
data.description: InterEarth is a Western Australian pure-play CDR startup pursuing woody biomass burial via its proprietary "Dry Stack" storage chambers, using plantation-grown native Eucalyptus and Acacia. Selected by Zurich Insurance for a pre-purchase agreement via Puro.earth, the project grows coppicing species on low-rainfall cleared farmland and buries the harvested biomass in engineered subterranean chambers to produce scalable, durable carbon removal. Its "InterEarth Bowgada" facility is listed on Puro.earth as a future supplier having passed preliminary assessment.
